map.工程近似 每 5.8℃ 温差约 1% 循环水量蒸发，即 G×ΔT/580，便于快: Engineering approximation: every 5.8°C of temperature difference evaporates about 1% of the circulating water, i.e. G x ΔT/580, for a quick makeup water estimate.
map.循环水量与进出水温差核算散热能力，校核冷却塔选型。: Circulating water volume and the inlet/outlet temperature difference give the heat rejection, which checks the cooling tower selection.

map.湿球温度逼近度评估冷却塔在高湿天气的表现。: Wet-bulb temperature approach assessment of how a cooling tower performs in humid weather.
map.蒸发水量怎么估？: How is evaporative water loss estimated?
map.越小出水越接近湿球、机组能效越高，但塔体尺寸与造价上升，按投资回收权衡。: The smaller the approach the closer the water leaves to the wet-bulb temperature and the higher the unit efficiency, but the tower gets larger and more expensive, so weigh it against investment recovery.
map.输入冷却水量、进出水温度与湿球温度，计算散热量及各项水损，并图表展示浓缩倍数对补: Enter the cooling water volume, the inlet and outlet water temperatures and the wet-bulb temperature to compute the heat rejection and each water loss, with a chart of how the concentration ratio affects makeup water.
map.：出水 32℃ 与湿球 27℃ 的接近度 = 5℃，越小塔越大越贵，需平衡投资与: : outlet water 32°C and wet bulb 27°C gives an approach of 5°C; the smaller it is the larger and more expensive the tower, balancing investment against condensation temperature.
map.：散热量 Q = 600×4.18×5 ÷ 3.6 ≈ 3483 kW；蒸发水量: : heat rejection Q = 600x4.18x5 / 3.6 ≈ 3483 kW; evaporative water ≈ 600x5 / 580 ≈ 5.17 m³/h, with makeup estimated as evaporation plus blowdown.
